decisions.reason: The low-pile decorative carpet stays close to the firm's textile and interior know-how, so it can keep reading market feedback and refining the design, though overlap with similar carpets after C's withdrawal leaves some rationalization risk.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet draws directly on the firm's material expertise and craftsmanship, giving it strong capacity to absorb feedback and anchor it in the premium range.
The low-pile carpet fits the established textile offer and the firm can interpret its results, but several similar carpets in the collection make it the most likely candidate for further pruning.
The swivel shell chair line builds on core seating knowledge across workplace and residential markets, so the firm can learn from results and improve the models over time.
